summary: Round 13 testing — pricing CRUD, events CRUD, R2 document upload/download/delete, public pricing/events endpoints, admin regression, FE Aurora + new logo + Emergent badge removal + Pricing/Events tabs all VERIFIED. Backend 20/20 PASS in new test_round13.py. R2 confirmed live (storage='r2', object_key='documents/...', download 307 redirects to signed URL).

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout (login_attempts collection) accumulates across test runs and locks out admin@wehive.co.in for ~14 min when prior iterations exercised wrong-password tests. Had to clear db.login_attempts to unblock browser-based admin login. Consider per-test-suite reset or shorter lockout window in test env.

Now that real SMTP is configured, response no longer contains dev_token/dev_mode — prior tests in test_admin_auth_password.py that assert on dev_token are obsolete and need updating to skip when SMTP is live or to read token from a different debug path.

ui_bugs.issue: Live preview only updates when value is typed (keyboard event). page.fill() does not trigger React onChange in this input — likely uses controlled input bound to onInput rather than onChange, or fill() bypass. Functional via keyboard; consider also handling change event to make programmatic fill work.
